fixture: canvas2d












Frame identity is readable from pixels: the 40x40 patch at canvas (10,10) — page
(50,130) to (90,170) — takes colour PALETTE[frame % 6], and the six palette
entries are saturated primaries that survive any colour quantisation the terminal
backend applies.




While playing, the page records requestAnimationFrame deltas and reports p50/p99 gaps.
That makes this fixture reusable as the repainting-page corpus for frame pacing —
same measurement, in-page, with no external profiler.
